q: A 45 year old man read an article that alcohol can cause liver cancer. He got anxious as he had consumed alcohol thrice in the past in social functions. He visited a hospital and demanded for liver biopsy to confirm the liver cancer. Doctors did only Liver Function test which was found to be normal. He was suggested to go home and reassured about his healthy liver. Inspite of reassurance, he visited multiple doctors and demanded liver biopsy. At last he manipulated his symptoms & LFT report and then asked a new doctor for liver biopsy. He is a case of;
e:
Factitious disorder: Hospital addiction.
• a/c Munchausen syndrome- Patient produces fake symptoms with the sole intention of seeking medical attention (hence c/a professional patients).
• When a caregiver produces fake symptoms to gain the attention, it is c/a
“Munchausen syndrome by proxy”*.
